items.t: Head gasket failure and overheating (Northstar head bolts)
items.job: Replace head gaskets with block thread inserts
items.note: RepairPal shows about $2,700-$3,700 at one shop; owners report $3,000-$5,600 once thread repair is included. Many owners replace the engine instead.

items.t: Engine burns oil
items.job: Diagnose oil use and clean stuck piston rings
items.note: Owners report about $2,000 on average; worn rings need far more costly engine work.

items.t: Oil leaks from the lower crankcase and oil pan seal
items.job: Reseal lower crankcase and oil pan
items.note: RepairPal lists oil pan gasket work at $1,406-$2,010; full lower crankcase reseals have cost owners $3,500 or more.

items.t: Stumble or stall when coming to a stop
items.job: Engine computer update or replacement
items.note: Often fixed by reprogramming. RepairPal lists PCM replacement at $734-$1,095.

items.t: Speedometer drops out and cruise control quits
items.job: Diagnose speed signal; replace sensor or update engine computer
items.note: Parts cost depends on whether a sensor or the PCM is at fault.

items.t: Front-end clunk or rattle over bumps
items.job: Replace front stabilizer links or bushings
items.note: RepairPal lists stabilizer link kits at $97-$164.

items.t: Rear air-leveling suspension problems
items.job: Replace air-leveling compressor
items.note: RepairPal lists the compressor at $784-$852. Leaking rear shocks add more.

items.t: A/C compressor runs all the time
items.job: A/C system diagnosis
items.note: RepairPal lists A/C diagnosis at $122-$179.

items.t: Heating and A/C door actuators fail
items.job: Replace HVAC air door actuator
items.note: RepairPal lists $745-$1,041; some actuators are much quicker to reach.

items.t: Power window drops into the door
items.job: Replace window regulator
items.note: RepairPal lists $517-$599; regulator motor only is $374-$544.

items.t: Headlights cut out while driving
items.job: Diagnose and replace headlight bulb or ballast
items.note: Owners report $150 for a bulb up to about $1,000.

items.t: Side airbag can deploy unexpectedly or not at all (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Cadillac dealer
items.note: Free at any Cadillac dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.
